## Failure list (`hard_baseline`, generated; every non-perfect question)

### h01 (synonym): Which warehouses are underused, below the level that triggers a closure review?

- expected (answered): Hat Yai (64%) and Da Nang (62%) are below 65%. Note the watch list needs two consecutive quarters below 65%; the report only gives an annual figure.
- got (refused): The document states that sites below 65% utilisation for two consecutive quarters are placed on a consolidation watch list, but it does not name any specific warehouses or provide utilisation figures for individual facilities, so it is impossible to identify which warehouses are underused.
- judge: wrong: The model claims the document doesn't name warehouses or utilisation figures, but the reference identifies Hat Yai (64%) and Da Nang (62%) as below 65%.
- retrieval: gold pages [7, 8], first gold rank 1, top 5: p7-x1, p3-x1, p2-x2, p3-s1, p9-x1
- unverified citations: 0 of 1
- oracle context (p7-x1, p7-f1, p7-t1, p8-x1): answered, judge correct: Two major facilities fell below the 65% threshold in 2025: TH-HDY (Hat Yai, Songkhla, Thailand, cross-dock, 64% utilisation) and VN-DNG (Da Nang, Vietnam, cross-dock, 62% utilisation). Note the document calls the consequence a 'consolidation watch list', not a closure review: sites below 65% for two consecutive quarters are placed on that list.

### h04 (table): Which single warehouse has the largest floor area, and how big is it?

- expected (answered): Lat Krabang, Bangkok (TH-LKB), 62,000 sqm
- got (answered): ID-SUB in Surabaya, Indonesia (ambient) is the largest warehouse at 33,500 sqm. This compares with the next largest, VN-BDG Binh Duong at 29,000 sqm, per the facilities table.
- judge: wrong: The answer names ID-SUB Surabaya (33,500 sqm) as largest, but the reference says Lat Krabang, Bangkok (TH-LKB) at 62,000 sqm is the largest warehouse.
- retrieval: gold pages [7], first gold rank 6, top 5: p5-x1, p4-x1, p6-x1, p11-x1, p8-x1
- unverified citations: 0 of 1
- oracle context (p7-x1, p7-f1, p7-t1): answered, judge correct: TH-LKB at Lat Krabang, Bangkok, Thailand, with 62,000 square metres, is the largest single warehouse in Table 2.
